ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for PREP. ONLY Prep students will be allowed to take this section. No exceptions. This section is for students who will take CS 233 for Honors Credit, including for the James Scholar program. Students not wanting to take CS 233 for Honors Credit should enroll in CS 233 ALR or ALP. In general, students wanting to take CS 233 for Honors Credit should seek the advice of their college to be sure they are following the rules for Honors Credit as determined by their college. Any student who is not a James Scholar but wanting honors credit can email undergrads@cs.illinois.edu to request access. For up-to-date information about CS course restrictions, please see the following link: http://go.cs.illinois.edu/csregister
